points.quote: **Framework (`blocksuite/framework/`)** is the generic core: ... **Affine layer (`blocksuite/affine/`)** builds the actual editor on that core
`store`: the Yjs-backed document and block model.
`std`: the block view layer, selection, services/extensions and the canvas (gfx) runtime.

`widgets/`: UI overlays such as the toolbar, slash-menu, drag-handle ... `fragments/`: side panels such as outline, frame-panel, doc-title ... The app's "page" and "edgeless" modes correspond to the document editor and the surface/gfx canvas.
The `packages/frontend/component` package wraps the Lit-based editor for React through its `lit-react` folder.
It is consumed as `@blocksuite/*` packages. About 1,100 imports come from `packages/` and 74 from `tests/`.
